viridian_leaf.name: a viridian leaf
viridian_leaf.description: A simple green leaf, prized by herbalists for its minor restorative properties.

althion_stem.name: an althion stem
althion_stem.description: A thick, fibrous stem that pulses with a faint magical energy.

sweetfern_leaf.name: a sweetfern leaf
sweetfern_leaf.description: A sugary leaf with jagged edges, known to clot blood and knit flesh quickly.

crimson_aloe.name: some crimson aloe
crimson_aloe.description: A thick, red-tinged gel that smells faintly of copper. It rapidly accelerates natural healing.

withered_root.name: a withered root
withered_root.description: A dry, spindly root. When chewed, it calms minor tremors and twitches in the nerves.

tormented_root.name: a tormented root
tormented_root.description: A twisted, knotty root that looks like it died in pain. It shocks the nervous system into repairing major trauma.

numb_needle.name: a numb-needle cactus
numb_needle.description: A small chunk of fleshy cactus meat that restores sensation to numbed areas where scars have formed.

barrel_cactus.name: some barrel cactus flesh
barrel_cactus.description: Potent, water-heavy cactus flesh that repairs deep-seated nerve damage and chronic shakes.

rosemarrow_potion.name: a rosemarrow potion
rosemarrow_potion.description: A sweet, pink distillation that clears concussions and eases headaches.

snapdragon_tea.name: a cup of snapdragon tea
snapdragon_tea.description: A spicy tea that helps mend fractured skulls and jaw injuries.

pennyroyal_stem.name: a pennyroyal stem
pennyroyal_stem.description: Chewing this fibrous stem fades minor facial scars and corrects slurred speech.

kingsfoil_leaf.name: a kingsfoil leaf
kingsfoil_leaf.description: A royal leaf with golden veins that repairs major disfigurement and deep cranial trauma.

basal_moss.name: some basal moss
basal_moss.description: Common dungeon moss that tastes like dirt, but knits minor organ bruising effectively.

pothinir_grass.name: some pothinir grass
pothinir_grass.description: A sharp, pungent grass that repairs ruptured organs and stems internal bleeding.

starfruit_berry.name: a star-fruit berry
starfruit_berry.description: A luminous, eye-shaped berry capable of regenerating a lost eye if consumed whole.

troll_moss.name: some troll-moss
troll_moss.description: Sticky, resilient moss that clears up shortness of breath and smooths internal scarring.

glow_lichen.name: some glow-lichen
glow_lichen.description: Bioluminescent lichen that scours deep scar tissue from vital organs.

knitbone_flower.name: a knit-bone flower
knitbone_flower.description: A small white flower that mends sprains and minor fractures in the limbs.

ambrosia_stalk.name: an ambrosia stalk
ambrosia_stalk.description: A rigid green stalk that sets and fuses broken bones almost instantly.

hydra_tongue.name: a hydra tongue
hydra_tongue.description: A rare, writhing plant frond that stimulates the rapid regrowth of a severed limb.

gingko_nut.name: a gingko nut
gingko_nut.description: Eating this nut restores flexibility to stiff joints scarred by old injuries.

ironwood_bark.name: some ironwood bark
ironwood_bark.description: Tough, fibrous bark that cures atrophied muscles and straightens malformed limbs.
